blocks.text:
Every icon darkened, badges in softer colours, and a heavier rail behind the status area, for a Home screen that sits back at night.

Icons are darkened by Folio, so apps that never shipped a dark icon get one too. Everything else - the shape of the icons, the date, the live clock - stays where Classic left it.

A built-in Folio theme. Applying it changes how Folio draws your Home screen and nothing else - it never touches other apps, and every setting it changes can be changed back by hand in Settings.

items: Dark icons, including for apps that ship none

entries.notes: The Dark theme becomes a package in the Folio Market. It has shipped with Folio since 0.4.0.
